verdict.rationale: Working Copy connects to your own servers over ssh, https, git and http using any repository URL you provide. It also documents configuring a plain Linux server, BSD server or Synology NAS as a hosting provider via SSH commands, and supports private GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea instances. That is a direct client-to-server connection to user-owned infrastructure. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that no cloud relay or proxy is involved, and independent hands-on corroboration of direct self-hosted server connections.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect directly to my servers without relying on a cloud relay, proxy, or VPN

citations.quote: Press + on the list of repositories and provide a URL pointing to your repository. Working Copy supports https, ssh, git, and http protocols.
configure a regular Linux server, BSD server & Synology NAS to act as a hosting provider, using SSH commands for listing repositories.
Working Copy supports private instances of GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea.
